claims.name: submission_lower
claims.header_template: ∃ S : List (Fin 22 → Fin 2), MinDist10Code S ∧ {k} ≤ S.length

claims.name: submission_upper
claims.header_template: ∀ S : List (Fin 22 → Fin 2), MinDist10Code S → S.length ≤ {k}

notes.lower: construction direction, identical formula to the solver sibling binary-code-a22-10: reward = 0 for k <= 2 (trivial repetition-code baseline {0^22, 1^22}); ((k - 2) / 62)^3 otherwise; k = 64 -> 1.0 (record matched, Östergård 2005); k >= 65 -> record_broken, scores above 1 not capped; k > 84 contradicts the published semidefinite-programming upper bound (Gijswijt-Mittelmann-Schrijver 2012) and is flagged for human review
notes.upper: upper-bound direction (no mass-production route currently): reward = 0 for m >= 460 (trivial sphere-packing bound floor(2^22 / 9109) = 460, radius-4 Hamming balls of volume 1+22+231+1540+7315 = 9109 are disjoint); ((460 - m) / 376)^3 otherwise; m = 84 -> 1.0 (record matched, Gijswijt-Mittelmann-Schrijver 2012); m <= 83 -> record_broken, scores above 1 not capped; m < 64 contradicts the published lower bound (Östergård 2005) and is flagged for human review
